plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into validated interactive HTML diagrams: architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, lifecycle, ERD, class, tree, timeline, waterfall, one-page explainers and stories. Packaged for ZCode from tt-a1i/archify.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把想法、计划或代码库转换成经过校验的交互式 HTML 图表：架构、工作流、时序、数据流、生命周期、ERD、类图、树、时间线、瀑布图，以及一页式讲解页和故事导出。打包自 tt-a1i/archify。
